name: net_seat_book_rules
description: The seats user://net.cfg notes for a game started again (Identity.hold_seat, held_seat, release_seat): one note per server, match and seat (a second replaces the first); the newest whose game no longer runs is offered, so a seat another window of this install still plays (Linux tells by /proc, so this runs on Linux: process 1 always runs) is skipped, and a note of this very process is offered; a note older than two hours is dropped, and at most eight are kept; release gives up only this process's note for that match, on that server; the sequence floor a note keeps (above every command number its game sent) only rises; another server's notes are its own; the device key beside them is untouched.

steps.msg: one note per seat, and this process's own is offered
the seat whose game still runs (process 1) is skipped for the newest whose game is gone
a note older than two hours, and anything malformed, is dropped
at most eight kept, the newest last
release gives up this process's note only: another game's for the same match stays
the device key in the same file is untouched
